flagged.title: Foundation Myths: Athens & Rome
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly attributes the founding of Alba Longa to Aeneas instead of his son Ascanius (Aeneas founded Lavinium), which would cost marks on foundation sequence questions in GCSE Classical Civilisation.

mark_affecting.quote: Aeneas flees west, and eventually founds a settlement in Italy called Alba Longa.

flagged.title: Journeying to the Underworld
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly presents Persephone's time division as an equal half-year seasonal split (spring/summer vs autumn/winter) rather than the prescribed Homeric Hymn's one-third below and two-thirds above, and attributes Virgil's 100-year wait to lacking an obol rather than being unburied.

mark_affecting.quote: She now splits her year: spring and summer above ground with her mother... and autumn and winter below ground as queen of the underworld

If you didn't have this exact coin, the obol, placed on your body when you were buried, your soul was literally stranded on the muddy riverbank of the Acheron for a hundred agonizing years before Charon would finally take you across for free.
